args.summary: I can't close browser tabs — my tools only control the page content of the current tab, not the browser's tab strip, so I have no way to enumerate or close the other tabs. To do this yourself: right-click any tab and choose "Close other tabs" (this keeps that tab and closes the rest), or press Ctrl+Shift+W (Cmd+Shift+W on Mac) to close all tabs and then reopen the one you want. If you'd like, I can navigate this tab to a specific page for you instead.
